about: X1: hover with no machine (G-code system A detected). column is 1-based, on the first character of the word.

hovers.markdown:
**G71** — Roughing cycle along Z

Roughs an outside or inside contour in passes along Z and leaves an allowance for the finishing cycle\. It is written in two blocks: depth of cut and retract first, then the profile range and the allowances\.

_Cycle_

**G76** — Multi\-pass threading cycle

Cuts a thread in several passes, taking less material each time\. Written in two blocks: the finishing passes, the pull\-out chamfer and the insert angle packed into P, the smallest cut depth and the finish allowance first; then the thread end, the taper, the thread height, the first cut depth and the lead\. F is the thread lead per revolution, not a feed rate\. P means two different things in the two blocks and one entry cannot tell them apart, so gEdit counts it rather than measuring it: the packed six digits of the first block are never converted, and the thread height of the second is shown as written\.

The feed carries the thread pitch here, so changing it changes the thread\.

_Cycle_

Required: F

**X** — X axis, a diameter

Position across the turning axis, written as a diameter while diameter programming is on\. With G4 it is a dwell time in seconds\.

**U** — Incremental X, a diameter

Distance to move across the turning axis, as a diameter\. Inside the multi\-pass cycles it is a depth of cut or an allowance on X instead, and with G4 a dwell time in seconds\.
